rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sovereign nation or state.

example.english: The laws in this country are very strict.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 faat3 leot6 hou2 jim4

rows.note: Use this for rural countryside as opposed to a town or city.

example.english: I lived in the country when I was young and played by the fields every day.
example.traditional: 我細個喺鄉下住，日日都去田邊玩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 zyu6 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 tin4 bin1 waan2

rows.note: Use this for an unspecified area, region, or district rather than a country or rural countryside.

example.english: Transport is very convenient in this country.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 gaau1 tung1 hou2 fong1 bin6
